ms.report:
Submission for Milestone 1: OgmiosDotnet
I’m thrilled to submit OgmiosDotnet for Milestone 1! 
This marks the successful development and open-sourcing of a robust C# client tailored for progressive reading of blockchain data from a specified start point. The client has been designed with performance, extensibility, and ease of integration in mind, making it a valuable tool for developers in the .NET ecosystem.
The project includes comprehensive documentation covering an overview, requirements, integration steps, and options for customization and configuration. This ensures developers can easily adopt the client and tailor it to their specific needs. To further promote collaboration and long-term usability, I implemented auto-generation of types from the Ogmios & Cardano schema, along with detailed instructions for generating these types. This approach futureproofs the client for new Ogmios versions and additional features while inviting contributions from the community.
Additionally, I created a set of unit tests that provide strong coverage for the ChainSynchronizationClient. These tests align with the functionality of the Ogmios TypeScript client, ensuring parity and reliability. While working on the client, I also developed the worker application planned for Milestone 3 (although not officially submitted yet). Building the worker application alongside the client made sense as it served as a natural testing environment and will facilitate the completion of later milestones.
・I’ve also introduced a MaxBlocksPerSecond configuration option, which allows rate-limiting for block requests. This feature is particularly useful when interacting with third-party services that may impose rate limits or become overwhelmed.
・Another significant addition is support for multiple parallel connections. This functionality enables connections to start from different points in the blockchain, improving synchronization times and efficiently utilizing resources from third-party service

ms.report:
Milestone 2 Submission
﻿
Overview
This milestone demonstrates the completion of the OgmiosDotnetClient, fulfilling the goal of enabling progressive reading of Cardano memory pool data. The deliverables align with the outlined outputs and acceptance criteria, showcasing functionality, integration, and accessibility for public use.
Milestone Outputs
The OgmiosDotnetClient is capable of progressively reading memory pool data from a specified slot. Its features include chain synchronization, snapshot acquisition, and detailed transaction insights. This functionality allows developers to monitor pending transactions and integrate Cardano blockchain data into their applications seamlessly.
Documentation has been modularized for clarity and ease of use. The core README.md file provides a high-level overview and links to module-specific documentation, offering clean navigation and ensuring developers can quickly find the information they need. This structure enables users to:
・Understand how to use the public package.
・Integrate it into new or existing .NET projects.
・Learn relevant concepts about Cardano's memory pool to maximize its utility.

The core README.md file is available in the GitHub repository.
Unit tests have been implemented to cover the core functionality required for reading Cardano memory pool data. All tests pass successfully, as detailed in the comprehensive test report and the test item ID, is reflected above the test case in code for reference. The testing strategy replicates and improves upon the coverage in the Ogmios TypeScript client, ensuring reliability and thoroughness.
Two packages have been successfully published on NuGet for public use:
・OgmiosDotnetClient.Services
・OgmiosDotnetClient.Schema

The schema package is intentionally separated from the services package, allowing developers to use the schema independently for custom implementations. This approach enhances flexibility and accessibility for different use cases.

Milestone 3 (Final) Submission: Delivery of Quick Start Application (Worker)
Overview
This milestone delivers a comprehensive Worker application, demonstrating the integration and functionality of the OgmiosDotnetClient. The Worker reads blockchain and mempool data, processes transactions, and persists the data into an in-memory PostgreSQL database. The implementation leverages Entity Framework Core, allowing developers to easily replace or extend the database provider for other use cases. Additionally, all projects have been upgraded to .NET 9.0, resulting in significant performance improvements (~32%) and ensuring compatibility with the latest supported .NET version.
Milestone Outputs
・Worker Application

・Capable of:
・Reading blockchain data from specified slots.
・Accessing and monitoring mempool transactions.
・Saving processed data into an in-memory PostgreSQL database.
・Modular and extendable architecture:
・Uses Entity Framework Core, enabling seamless substitution of the PostgreSQL database provider with alternatives supported by Entity Framework.
・Customizable for specific blockchain and mempool event handling.

・Documentation

・Detailed guides available in the repository, covering:
・Setting up and configuring the Worker application.
・Demonstrating blockchain and mempool data processing.
・Database integration using Entity Framework Core, with instructions for extending functionality for alternative providers.
